title: Delightful Almond Bhuna
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish made with almonds, a sweet and spicy sauce, and your choice of protein. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes per side.
3. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the sliced almonds to the skillet and cook until toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
5. Add the bhuna sauce to the skillet and stir to combine with the almonds.
6. Add the garam masala, cumin, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
7. Return the chicken to the skillet and simmer until the sauce has thickened, about 5 minutes.
8. Serve the chicken and sauce over rice or with naan bread.
9. Garnish with sliced almonds and a sprinkle of cilantro, if desired.
